verdict.rationale: YYLO can ingest external feedback (Slack messages, GitHub issues) directly into its kanban/ledger as structured tasks (yylo-docs-10), and a dedicated `feedback-yylo` CLI binary is confirmed live on npm (yylo-probe-rt-1), suggesting a feedback-to-task pathway exists. However, there is no documented mechanism for generating a 'proposed scope' alongside the task — no scope estimation, sizing, or planning artifact is described anywhere in the docs or GitHub evidence. Missing for 10: explicit scope-proposal output tied to feedback conversion, documentation of what the feedback-yylo binary actually produces, and any PM-facing evidence of structured scoping fields.
